description: 3 exemplars (1 de) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Near-misses are the sharper adversarial ask (adversarial-review), the narrower single-lens authorization review (authz-review) and writing the PR text rather than reviewing the change. Counterexamples guard the 'review' and 'check' vocabulary in unrelated work. Classes declared 2026-11-03 when the corpus moved with the rename from code-review.

queries.q: check my changes before I open the PR
schau dir bitte meinen Diff an
be brutal and tear this design apart
queries.note: a teardown on explicit request → adversarial-review
one lens, the authorization chain → authz-review

queries.q: write the PR description for this branch
queries.note: authoring the PR text, not reviewing the change

queries.q: review the quarterly sales numbers with the finance team
check whether the staging server has enough disk space
